title: A call to a function in neither the core set nor any group is an error when the description is loaded
description: frobnicate() names no HEL 1.0 function. The description declares no HEL version, so it declares 1.0, which the evaluator implements; a later 1.x version may only add functions without changing what a 1.0 expression yields, so the name is a Type / HEL error now, not a deferred Null.
